query:
SELECT id, project_id, title, status, planned_date AS "planned_date: chrono::NaiveDate",
                  assignee_id, priority, created_at AS "created_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>", updated_at AS "updated_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>"
           FROM tasks
           WHERE project_id = $1
           ORDER BY
                CASE status
                    WHEN 'current' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'next'    THEN 1
                    WHEN 'todo'    THEN 2
                    ELSE 3
                END,
                CASE priority
                    WHEN 'urgent' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'high'   THEN 1
                    WHEN 'normal' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'low'    THEN 3
                    ELSE 4
                END,
                planned_date NULLS LAST,
                created_at
